verdict.line: You lose if you trade autos into an active Counter Strike or let the first five levels decide the lane; you win if you push exactly when his E (Counter Strike) is down and convert stacked Hemorrhage into a level 6+ Guillotine execute.

brief.thesis: Jax's E (Counter Strike) dodges incoming basic attacks and then stuns everyone around him, so every auto-attack trade you start while it's active is wasted and still ends in a stun. Darius's E (Apprehend) is a pull, not a basic attack, so it goes through that dodge window untouched — it's your answer to Counter Strike and your engage tool whenever it's down. That's why the measured numbers split the way they do: Jax owns the early lane and solo-kill race (he has Leap Strike and Counter Strike online first), but Darius's true-damage Guillotine and bleed stacking claw the matchup back to 50.1% over 3491 games.

theirWindow.when: Jax activates E (Counter Strike) on you
theirWindow.what: Stop auto-attacking immediately — they're dodged for the duration and you still eat the stun at the end. Either back out of his hit-range or land E (Apprehend) instead, since the pull isn't a basic attack and bypasses the dodge entirely.

yourWindow.when: his E (Counter Strike) is on cooldown (18/16/14/12/10s)
yourWindow.what: This is exactly the OP.GG read: apply pressure now. Fire E (Apprehend) to pull him in, stack Hemorrhage with Q (Decimate) and autos, and commit — he has no stun or dodge to punish the all-in.

runes.keystoneWhy: The 49.2%-WR Precision/Resolve page stacks Conqueror through the extended trades this matchup forces, and converts to healing that outlasts his R (Relentless Assault) attack-speed scaling.

summoners.why: Exhaust+Flash is the highest-measured combo at 52.4% WR, and it's the right tool mechanically — it cuts Jax's attack speed right when his R (Relentless Assault) is ramping and softens his Leap Strike engage. Flash+Ghost (66.4% pick) is the safer default if you'd rather prioritize disengage.

playing.title: Push when his E is down
playing.detail: Counter Strike is his only answer to an all-in. The moment it's on cooldown (18/16/14/12/10s by rank), use E (Apprehend) to pull him in and start stacking Hemorrhage.

playing.title: Never auto an active Counter Strike
playing.detail: Basic attacks thrown during his E channel are dodged for nothing and you still take the stun at the end. Disengage during the animation, then punish the instant it expires.

playing.title: Pull through the dodge window
playing.detail: E (Apprehend) isn't a basic attack, so it lands even while Counter Strike is active — it's the one tool you have that isn't wasted on him mid-channel.

playing.title: End trades fast, don't auto-war
playing.detail: R (Relentless Assault) gives Jax stacking attack speed with every strike and a bonus-damage proc every third hit, so prolonged auto trades favor him. Burst with Q (Decimate) + E (Apprehend) + autos and disengage rather than standing in extended exchanges.

playing.title: Track his Leap Strike range
playing.detail: Leap Strike is 700 range (17/14/11/8/5s cooldown) and lets him reset off minions or jungle camps to escape your all-in — don't commit R (Noxian Guillotine) if he still has a leap target nearby to flee through.

playing.title: Save Guillotine for max stacks
playing.detail: Noxian Guillotine's true damage scales with Hemorrhage stacks, so land Q, autos, and E first before leaping in with R for the execute, and remember a kill refreshes its cooldown.

playing.title: Respect empowered Leap Strike bursts
playing.detail: If he has W (Empower) up, his next Leap Strike or auto hits noticeably harder — hold W (Crippling Strike) to slow him off you rather than trading face-to-face into it.

brief.patchCaveat: The build path, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/sample figures above are pulled directly from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.20.1) — only the mechanical reasoning (why Counter Strike punishes autos, why Guillotine timing matters, why extended trades favor his R) is my own tactical read, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid Jax’s Leap Strike (Q) – Counter Strike (E) by using [E]. Apply pressure when his (E) is on cooldown to gain lane control.
